mission: Build the curated versioned DRILL LIBRARY infrastructure: per-drill schema, fault→drill mapping evidence records with real-coach endorsement provenance, and a recommendation gate that abstains from personalized recommendation unless every evidence condition holds. Seed ONLY Tier-C/UNVALIDATED content; prove unvalidated mappings can never be recommended.
method: New module packages/swing-lab/src/drillLibrary.ts (drill-library-v1) alongside — not replacing — the v0 schema in coachReview.ts (v0 ids preserved via a supersedes field so existing coach drillSuggestions stay interpretable). Structural validators enforce the honesty invariants (COACH_VALIDATED requires ≥2 independent real-coach endorsements with off-repo credential refs + on-disk review refs and stated agreement ≥0.7; Tier-C can never be GOLD; synthetic coach ids rejected; UNVALIDATED records must carry zero endorsements). evaluateDrillRecommendation() is the single sanctioned diagnosis→drill path: it requires a validated fault source (real coach review or a validated evaluator — machine-proposed and engineer-labeled sources are rejected), diagnosis confidence ≥0.7, COACH_VALIDATED drill AND mapping (structurally re-validated at gate time so a forged state flag still abstains), a technique profile whose evaluator is not BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION and whose drillMappingVersion matches drill-library-v1, stroke-family coverage, severity within the endorsed band, and every context restriction KNOWN TRUE — otherwise it abstains with explicit reasons, identically in production and research modes.
deliverables: packages/swing-lab/src/drillLibrary.ts — DrillEntryV1 schema (drillId, name, supportedStrokeFamilies, faultMappingIds, coachProvenance, purpose, instructions, equipment, difficulty, repsOrDuration, progressions, regressions, safetyNotes, mediaRefs, provenance, evidenceTier, validationState, version), FaultDrillMappingV1 evidence records (endorsing coaches, endorsement count via agreement, stroke/severity/context restrictions, agreement fraction, version), validators, recommendation gate, 7 Tier-C UNVALIDATED seed drills + 10 UNVALIDATED zero-endorsement mappings, library-level integrity check, CLI emitter (pnpm --filter @pickle/swing-lab coach:drills)
datasets/coach-review/drills/fault-drill-mappings.v1.json — derived artifact (10 UNVALIDATED mappings, gate thresholds stated in-file)

packages/swing-lab/test/drillLibrary.test.ts — 21 tests: every seed is Tier-C/UNVALIDATED with no coach provenance and zero endorsements; validators reject forged validation states, synthetic coaches, insufficient endorsements, low agreement; the gate ABSTAINS on every seeded mapping in production AND research mode, abstains for every live TECHNIQUE_ANALYSIS_PROFILES_V1 profile (all BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION), abstains on machine/engineer fault sources, low confidence, out-of-band severity, unknown/false context, uncovered stroke family, and structurally forged evidence; recommends only on a fully-validated hypothetical fixture
eslint.config.mjs — drillLibrary.ts added to the existing CLI no-console allowlist (same class as coachReview.ts)

gates.test: pnpm test — all workspace packages green (swing-lab 614 passed | 4 skipped, incl. 21 new drillLibrary tests)
gates.formatCheck: pnpm format:check — all files use Prettier code style

truthConstraints.noFabrication: Zero coach reviews, endorsements, or validations were created; all seeds are marked Tier-C UNVALIDATED with provenance strings stating they are engineering proposals for coaches to endorse or reject.
truthConstraints.blockedOnValidation: The gate abstains for every live technique profile because TECHNIQUE_ANALYSIS_PROFILES_V1 carries techniqueEvaluator=BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION and drillMappingVersion=none — this lock is consumed and verified, not weakened.
truthConstraints.heldOut: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched (no dataset case files modified).

irreduciblyExternal: Real qualified-coach endorsements of fault→drill mappings (≥2 independent coaches per mapping with stated agreement) — the only thing that can flip validationState to COACH_VALIDATED
Coach authorship/endorsement of drill entries themselves (coachProvenance)
A validated technique evaluator (GATE A) so fault diagnoses can come from a validated source; until then even a fully-validated mapping cannot fire in production
verdict: GREEN (infrastructure) · BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (coach evidence) — the recommendation gate provably abstains on the entire shipped library; when real coaches arrive, only their endorsements are missing.
